subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: What does a confusion matrix summarize?
options: one of a set of predefined classes
the number of rules generated for each class
features into a single class label
options_en: one of a set of predefined classes
the number of rules generated for each class
features into a single class label
questions.explanation: A confusion matrix shows the correct and incorrect predictions made by a classification model.

questions.question: A patient has cancer and the model predicts cancer. Which outcome is this?
questions.question_ar: مريض مصاب بالسرطان والنموذج يتنبأ بالسرطان. ما هذه النتيجة؟
questions.explanation: A patient has cancer. The model predicts cancer. This is a True Positive .

questions.question: A patient does not have cancer and the model predicts no cancer. Which outcome is this?
questions.question_ar: مريض غير مصاب بالسرطان والنموذج يتنبأ بعدم الإصابة. ما هذه النتيجة؟
questions.explanation: The model predicts no cancer. This is a True Negative .

questions.question: Which outcome can be considered a false alarm?
questions.question_ar: أي نتيجة يمكن اعتبارها إنذاراً كاذباً؟
questions.explanation: Both false positives and false negatives are important

questions.question: Which outcome occurs when the actual class is positive but the model predicts negative?
questions.question_ar: أي نتيجة تحدث عندما تكون الفئة الفعلية موجبة لكن النموذج يتنبأ بالسلبية؟
questions.explanation: Both false positives and false negatives are important

questions.question: In a False Positive, what is the actual class?
questions.question_ar: في الإيجابي الكاذب، ما الفئة الفعلية؟
questions.explanation: Both false positives and false negatives are important

questions.question: In a False Negative, what does the model predict?
questions.question_ar: في السلبي الكاذب، ماذا يتنبأ النموذج؟
questions.explanation: Both false positives and false negatives are important

questions.question: Which error can be particularly serious in some medical applications?
questions.question_ar: أي خطأ قد يكون خطيراً على نحو خاص في بعض التطبيقات الطبية؟
questions.explanation: Both false positives and false negatives are important
